Family controls require the Education service. They do not replace device management: TV settings, service removal, HDMI inputs and each streaming app’s profiles remain controlled by the TV or app.
No supported app is installed. In adult mode, install YouTube or ABC iview from the TV store, then return here.

In YouTube, select the child’s YouTube Kids profile and set a YouTube parent code to protect other profiles and signed-out viewing. This launcher cannot select or lock that profile for you. Confirm only after setting it up in the app.

In ABC iview, create and select a child profile with ABC Kids content. This launcher opens ABC iview and cannot prevent profile switching inside that app. Check its parental controls before approving it.
